title: Spec Main Shape Gate red on every PR head: `plugin-designer` NavigationDesigner has no `doc` entry after objectstack#19789 added the `doc` navigation type
body:
Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3 (`session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`), while reading PR objectui#10283's red check. ⛔ Unlabelled on purpose: `domain:*` and priority are the triage seat's.

## What fails

`Spec Main Shape Gate` (compile objectui against `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `main`) fails on PR objectui#10283 head `df2d7a4c6`, job `107710674151`, step 「Report which objectui file fails against which objectstack commit」. Annotations, verbatim:

- `packages/plugin-designer/src/NavigationDesigner.tsx:82` — `TS2741: Property 'doc' is missing in type … but required in type 'Record<"object" | … | "doc", …>'` — compiled against `@objectstack/spec` built from `objectstack-ai/objectstack@ccccdcc35eac`.
- then, as a consequence of `plugin-designer` failing to build: `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:75-77` — `TS7016: Could not find a declaration file for module '@object-ui/plugin-designer'`.

## Why it is not the PR's

- objectstack `ccccdcc35eac` is objectstack#19789, 「feat(spec): doc navigation item targeting a book and/or a doc」, committed 2026-09-24T15:09Z. It widens the navigation-item type union with `doc`, and `NavigationDesigner.tsx`'s per-type `Record` must now name it.
- On objectui `origin/main` `NavigationDesigner.tsx` has **0** `doc:` hits (control: the file's last touch `4c6f549` is an ancestor of the PR head, so the PR carries main's copy unchanged). objectui main's own last run of this gate (on `6099dd870`) was green because it predates the spec change; its next run will be red.
- ⇒ every open objectui PR re-run after 2026-09-24T15:09Z reads this red. The gate is advisory (not in the queue's required set), so the queue is not blocked, but the signal is dead until this lands.

## Fix shape (a lead, not a spec)

Add the `doc` member to the per-type `Record` in `packages/plugin-designer/src/NavigationDesigner.tsx` (label key, colour, icon), matching its siblings. objectui#10188 is the full feature (Studio doc editor + menu rendering) and was unblocked when objectstack#19482 closed at 2026-09-24T15:44Z; this card is only the compile stanch so the gate reads again, and whoever takes objectui#10188 builds on it (or folds it, if it lands first).
